nodes.description: Immutable-ish ChainLink price feed address stored in Basic, read by getPrices for the ETH/USD comparison and price query.
Public constant string name of InstaChainLinkResolver (metadata state variable).
Internal pure helper in Basic that converts bytes to uint256 using inline assembly mload(add(_bytes,0x20)) without validating the byte length.
Public view function in Resolver that loops over caller-supplied price feed addresses, performs low-level staticcalls for latestAnswer()/decimals(), and builds PriceData results.
Parameter _bytes of toUint256; raw external return data passed into the assembly mload conversion.
Parameter priceFeeds of getPrices; array of arbitrary addresses supplied by the caller and used as staticcall targets.
Named return local value of toUint256 holding the unpacked uint256 from assembly.
Loop counter of getPrices; incremented with unchecked arithmetic under solc 0.7.
Raw bytes returned by the latestAnswer() staticcall on a caller-supplied feed.
Raw bytes returned by the decimals() staticcall on a caller-supplied feed.
Return array of PriceData assembled from caller-supplied price feeds.
Return PriceData for the ETH/USD feed read from state variable ethUsdPriceFeed.
Inline assembly mload(add(_bytes,0x20)) in toUint256; blindly reads 32 bytes from calldata-derived bytes without length checks.
Low-level staticcall to caller-controlled address priceFeeds[i] using abi.encodeWithSignature for latestAnswer() and decimals(); return data is trusted and unchecked.
Unchecked loop arithmetic i++ and array indexing in getPrices under Solidity 0.7 (no overflow/underflow protection).

edges.reason: Parameter _bytes is passed into the inline assembly mload conversion.
Assembly mload result is assigned to the local value.
value returned by toUint256 is consumed inside getPrices when building PriceData.
Inline assembly block executes inside the toUint256 function body.
Caller-supplied priceFeeds[i] address is used directly as the staticcall target.
Return bytes of the latestAnswer() staticcall are stored in priceData.
Return bytes of the decimals() staticcall are stored in decimalsData.
Loop index i selects which price feed is called in each iteration.
Loop counter is incremented without overflow protection in solc 0.7.
Array writes into tokensPriceInETH are indexed by the unchecked loop counter.
getPrices reads the ethUsdPriceFeed state variable to compare against priceFeeds[i] and to query the ETH price.
getPrices performs the untrusted external staticcalls to price feed contracts.
getPrices invokes the toUint256 helper on the raw staticcall return data.
ethPriceInUsd is returned from getPrices after being populated from the ETH/USD feed.
tokensPriceInETH is returned from getPrices after being populated in the loop.
Caller-supplied priceFeeds array drives iteration and result construction in getPrices.

normalization_plan.reason: _bytes is a parameter of the toUint256 function and should be normalized into it.
priceFeeds is a parameter of getPrices and should be normalized into it.
value is the return local of toUint256 and carries no independent semantics.
i is a purely local loop counter inside getPrices.
priceData only holds the result of the external staticcall and is transient.
decimalsData only holds the result of the external staticcall and is transient.
tokensPriceInETH is a return value of getPrices and has no standalone role.
ethPriceInUsd is a return value of getPrices and has no standalone role.
